runtime: Actual application sources and controlled DOM disclosure nodes

results.name: Adapter loading does not render, mutate application state or replace source read models
Dashboard and all report perspectives retain exact prior content, values, controls and routes
Detail routes retain their prior scope, currency, date and source checks
Captured pack and read-only builder presentation leave the frozen renderer and snapshot unchanged
No-access and invalid-filter reporting states retain the original blocker and disabled controls
Printing opens only reporting analysis and restores every prior disclosure state
Repeated print-entry events do not overwrite original disclosure state or captured output
Native print listeners are installed without triggering print or opening disclosures on load
